summary: Remove the active CIRP project-budget module and establish a fixed Kapolei comparison of CIRP plus DeepSeek against direct-PDF Codex answers.
decision_refs: User clarification on 2026-09-27 that the target is CIRP product-answer quality after DeepSeek, not standalone DeepSeek accuracy
approval_evidence: The user explicitly cancelled all CIRP budget modules and authorized the live DeepSeek-backed CIRP product comparison.
known_limitations: Legacy budget tables and old status codes remain inert for data-compatible upgrades.
The Kapolei score is one project-path validation and is not a general construction-accuracy certification.
The completed benchmark found retrieval and adjacent-fragment grouping to be the dominant sampled accuracy limit; only 2 of 15 answers were fully usable.
